description: The line plot titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset" illustrates the performance metrics of different model variants in the context of hate speech detection. The x-axis, labeled "Model Variants," is categorical, representing various configurations of the model, including "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)," is linear, with values ranging from approximately 56% to 66%, indicating the percentage of correct predictions or performance scores. The plot features three lines, each representing a different metric: "Precision," "Recall," and "F1-score." The "Precision" line is marked with circles and a solid line, the "Recall" line with squares and a solid line, and the "F1-score" line with diamonds and a solid line. The "Precision" line starts at 65.78% for the "Full model (Ours)" and ends at 65.44% for the "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The "Recall" line begins at 65.78% and ends at 56.82%. The "F1-score" line starts at 65.45% and ends at 57.74%. The plot includes annotations of the exact metric values at each data point, providing a clear and precise representation of the performance metrics across the different model variants. The grid in the background aids in the visual assessment of the data points' positions relative to the axes. The figure is saved as "8-51398.jpg" in JPEG format with a resolution of 300 dots per inch (dpi).
